newsitem.title: CANADA: Moore Corp sells stake in Japan venture.
newsitem.headline: Moore Corp sells stake in Japan venture.

text.p: Moore Corp Ltd said on Monday it agreed to divest the remaining 10 percent equity holding in its Japanese joint venture with Toppan Printing Co Ltd, Toppan Moore Co Ltd.
Moore will receive roughly US$100 million for the stake when the transaction closes on March 25.
Under a technology deal, Toppan Moore will have the right to use some of Moore's proprietary technologies on a royaly basis. Toppan Moore will no longer use Moore's trade name and trademarks.

"Moore remains committed to the Japanese market. This change will give us greater flexibility to exploit our technologies in Japan with a variety of partners," Reto Braun, chairman and chief executive of Moore, said in a statement.
